item.title: Whiskers 0.8.63
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.63

### Audio Capture & Studio

  • Added Audio Capture so you can record audio from a selected app and send it straight to Studio for transcription
  • Redesigned Studio with a unified place to record app audio, import files, and manage transcript jobs
  • Added clearer model capability indicators so you can see when features such as speaker labels are available

    • ### Transcript Chat

  • Added transcript chat for asking questions about a recording
  • Added contextual transcript actions so suggested edits can be applied directly when appropriate

    • ### Speaker Labels

  • Improved speaker-label handling for compatible transcription services
  • Preserved corrected speaker turns when using AI Enhancement

    • ### Reliability

  • Improved recovery for interrupted app-audio capture and prevented empty recordings from entering the transcription queue
